a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Storm Burst''' is a [[channelling]] [[spell]] skill that creates orbs of energy that that move and jump around the target location, dealing [[Physical damage|physical]] and [[lightning damage]] in an [[area]] with each jump. When the channel is released, the orbs detonate to deal more damage in a larger area. ==Skill function and interaction== Channelling Storm Burst creates a cluster of pulsing orbs that follow the mouse pointer. Enemies can be hit by multiple orbs, but the orbs spawn in a spread out pattern resembling buckshot. Each orb created has its own duration tracker. Every 0.4 seconds, the orbs will jump to a new location around the cursor and deal [[Area of Effect]] damage. This 0.4 seconds interval is independent for each orb. When the player stops channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area based on duration remaining. The extra damage is not dealt when the orbs jump around or when it expires. Orbs created by [[totem]]s will also explode if the totem releases the channel by dying, expiring, or being resummoned. * '''[[Area of Effect]]''': Area of Effect modifiers affect the radius of the explosion caused by each orb, but '''does not affect''' the spread of the orbs from the cursor. Thus, increasing AoE will result in more overlapping explosions and higher hit rate.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/ay564f/synthesis_gem_information/ehypntr/ * '''[[Cast Speed]]''': Cast speed modifiers affect the rate at which new orbs are created, but '''does not affect''' the jump interval (0.4s). * '''[[Skill Duration]]''': Skill duration modifiers affect how long each orb stays on the ground before expiring and exploding. However, because the skill deals damage at an interval of 0.4 seconds, investing in skill duration will only have a meaningful effect if it would bring the total duration to the next breakpoint in multiples of 0.4 seconds (i.e. 1.6 seconds, 2.0 seconds, 2.4 seconds, etc.) There is no difference between 2.01 seconds and 2.39 seconds, or any other duration that is not a multiple of 0.4.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/ay564f/synthesis_gem_information/ehz90d7/ ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Physical
